meta.name: The Pyramid Scheme
meta.description:
Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Who Is Lucky?
videos.overview: Poor shop owner Goldy learns his grandfather Gabbar has a windfall; meeting Chunmun draws him into Jumbolife and sparks his ambition.

videos.title: Easy Hai Ya Bahut Easy?
videos.overview: Goldy joins the business but struggles to recruit members. He spots Manoj Srivastava, a skilled speaker, and decides to bring him in.

videos.title: Demo Dein Kya?
videos.overview: At late Dadi's birthday gathering, family clashes over a secret about Sarthak and Satkar, while Goldy and Srivastava recruit relatives into Jumbolife.

videos.title: Jumbolife Kya Hai?
videos.overview: At a Jumbolife picnic, Goldy is rewarded and plans a grand event with Tarun Bajaj, TV star Randheer Chaudhary, and influencer Skirty Kirti.

videos.title: Fly High
videos.overview: Goldy's team thrives as he hosts events with Manish, while Srivastava shines as a speaker. At a college pitch, Pratham exposes them, sparking chaos.

videos.title: Paradise
videos.overview: In Thailand, Goldy focuses on work while Srivastava is dazzled by glamour. Shravan and Daljeet try to divide them, pitching 'Hollywood Paradise'.

videos.title: Error 404 : Not Found
videos.overview: Daljeet denies the scam, but Goldy digs deeper. As he uncovers disturbing truths, a powerful backlash hits, leaving him shaken.
